shortDescription: Unauthorized UPI Transaction and Mobile Phone Theft
detailedDescription:
On 18 July 2026, around 7:45 PM, I was walking near CG Road, Navrangpura, Ahmedabad, after leaving a café.

A man riding a black motorcycle suddenly approached me from behind and snatched my mobile phone from my hand before speeding away towards Law Garden.

The stolen phone is a Samsung Galaxy S23 Ultra (Black, 256GB). The phone contains my banking applications, Aadhaar, PAN card copies, and personal photographs.

Around twenty minutes later, I noticed multiple unauthorized UPI transactions from my SBI bank account. A total amount of ₹48,500 was transferred to two unknown accounts using Google Pay.

I immediately blocked my SIM card and contacted the SBI customer care to freeze my account.

Several people nearby witnessed the incident, and a shop owner informed me that CCTV cameras outside the store may have recorded both the motorcycle and the suspect.

The suspect appeared to be a male aged approximately 25–30 years, around 5 feet 9 inches tall, medium build, wearing a black helmet, dark blue jacket, and blue jeans. The motorcycle appeared to be a black Bajaj Pulsar with a partially visible registration number ending in 4721.

I request the police to investigate the theft, identify the suspect, recover my phone, trace the unauthorized financial transactions, and take appropriate legal action.
